title: Andaman Tour Package
overview: Planning an island holiday is easy with an Andaman Tour Package that combines hotels, sightseeing, transfers, and activities in one plan. Whether travelling with family, friends, or your partner, you can choose a package that fits your budget. Enjoy beautiful beaches, clear waters, peaceful islands, exciting activities, and a memorable vacation without the stress of detailed planning. An Andaman Tour Package is designed to make your island vacation comfortable and well-organized — covering Port Blair's historic sites, Havelock Island's world-renowned Radhanagar and Elephant beaches, and Neil Island's tranquil lagoons and natural coral formations.
highlights: 2 Nights Havelock Island beachfront resort + 1 Night Neil Island + 2 Nights Port Blair
Confirmed Makruzz/Nautika Luxury High-Speed Catamaran cruise tickets between islands
Visit Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7 - Asia’s Best Beach) for golden sunset views
Speedboat excursion to Elephant Beach with live coral reef snorkeling and water sports
Historic Cellular Jail Light & Sound Show + Corbyn’s Cove Beach
Natural Rock Formation (Howrah Bridge), Bharatpur Beach & Laxmanpur sunset at Neil Island
Dedicated on-ground island coordinators at all airport and jetty arrival points
inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in handpicked beach resorts and premium hotels
Airport pickup and drop transfers in Port Blair by private AC cab
All inter-island ferry tickets in Premium AC Catamaran (Port Blair – Havelock – Neil – Port Blair)
All private AC transfers on Port Blair, Havelock Island, and Neil Island
Cellular Jail entry tickets and evening Light & Sound show passes
Sightseeing tours as per itinerary with local island assistance
All applicable taxes, toll, parking, and jetty charges
exclusions: Airfare to and from Port Blair
Water sports and activity fees (Scuba diving, sea walk, parasailing, jet ski)
Lunch and dinners, unless specifically mentioned
Personal expenses, room service, laundry, and tips

itinerary.title: Port Blair Arrival, Corbyn’s Cove & Cellular Jail Light & Sound
itinerary.description: Arrive at Port Blair Airport where our representative receives you and transfers you to the hotel. In the afternoon, visit Corbyn’s Cove Beach for coconut water and coastal views, followed by the historic Cellular Jail and its moving evening Light & Sound presentation. Overnight stay in Port Blair.
itinerary.stay: Sinclairs Bayview / Symphony Samudra 4★, Port Blair

itinerary.title: High-Speed Ferry to Havelock Island & Radhanagar Sunset
itinerary.description: Board the luxury Makruzz / Nautika catamaran to Havelock Island across azure seas. Check in to your beach resort. Later, witness the world-famous sunset at Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7). Overnight stay in Havelock.
itinerary.stay: Barefoot at Havelock / Symphony Palms Beach Resort 4★, Havelock

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Scuba, Snorkeling & Water Sports
itinerary.description: Speedboat ride to Elephant Beach. Indulge in snorkeling among vibrant live corals, sea walking, or discover scuba diving with certified dive instructors. Spend the afternoon relaxing at the resort. Overnight stay in Havelock.
itinerary.stay: Barefoot at Havelock / Symphony Palms Beach Resort 4★, Havelock

itinerary.title: Havelock to Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep) & Natural Bridge
itinerary.description: Cruise to the serene island of Neil. Visit the famous Howrah Bridge (natural living coral rock formation), Bharatpur Beach for shallow reef swimming, and Laxmanpur Beach for a breathtaking sunset. Overnight stay in Neil Island.
itinerary.stay: Summer Sands Beach Resort / Pearl Park 4★, Neil Island

itinerary.title: Neil Island to Port Blair & Local Handicraft Market
itinerary.description: Board the return catamaran ferry back to Port Blair. In the afternoon, visit Sagarika Government Emporium for pearl jewellery and seashell handicrafts, with time for a farewell seafood dinner. Overnight stay in Port Blair.
itinerary.stay: Sinclairs Bayview / Symphony Samudra 4★, Port Blair

itinerary.title: Port Blair Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and transfer to Port Blair Airport for your flight back home with unforgettable memories of tropical turquoise waters and pristine beaches.

faqs.question: What is included in an Andaman tour package?
faqs.answer: A standard Andaman tour package includes hotel and beach resort accommodation, airport transfers, inter-island high-speed catamaran ferry tickets (Port Blair, Havelock, Neil), private vehicle transfers on every island, sightseeing tours (Cellular Jail, Radhanagar Beach, Elephant Beach, Natural Bridge), daily breakfast, and dedicated island coordinators at every jetty.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit Andaman?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit Andaman is from October to May when the weather is pleasant, the skies are clear, and the sea is calm — perfect for scuba diving, snorkeling, sea walks, and inter-island cruising.

faqs.question: How can I save money on an Andaman trip?
faqs.answer: Book 60 to 90 days in advance to get lower flight fares to Port Blair, choose combo island packages that bundle catamaran ferries with local transfers, and select hotels that include breakfast. Travelling in October or early March also offers great value without peak season hotel surcharges.

faqs.question: Is an Andaman tour package suitable for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Andaman is extremely safe and well-organized for families. Pre-arranged private cabs and reserved high-speed ferries eliminate logistics stress, and beaches like Radhanagar and Bharatpur have gentle waves suitable for children and older family members.

faqs.question: Can I customize activities like Scuba Diving or Candlelight Dinners?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can pre-book PADI-certified discover scuba diving (with underwater photos/video), underwater sea walks, parasailing, and private candlelight beach dinners on Havelock Island.
